blocks.goal: Remove the item-spawning compatibility methods from Misc and use the existing cohesive item-spawning API in MiscItemSpawner.

inputs: Misc.spawnItemsTowardsLocation(Player, Location, Location, ItemStack, int, double, ItemSpawnReason)
Misc.spawnItemTowardsLocation(Player, Location, Location, ItemStack, double, ItemSpawnReason)
outputs: Call sites that invoke the corresponding methods on MiscItemSpawner
ops.details: Replace callers of the forwarding methods in Misc with direct calls to the corresponding existing methods in MiscItemSpawner. Preserve argument order, nullability, return values, and overload selection.

inputs: spawnItemsTowardsLocation(Player, Location, Location, ItemStack, int, double, ItemSpawnReason)
spawnItemTowardsLocation(Player, Location, Location, ItemStack, double, ItemSpawnReason)
outputs: Misc without the item-spawning forwarding methods
MiscItemSpawner as the single owner of the item-spawning API
ops.details: Consolidate the forwarding methods into the existing MiscItemSpawner implementation. Do not create duplicate overloads; retain the existing MiscItemSpawner implementations and remove the obsolete forwarding declarations from Misc after call sites have been updated.

blocks.goal: Remove the NPC-related compatibility delegates from Misc and use the existing cohesive NPCUtil API.

outputs: Call sites that invoke the corresponding methods on NPCUtil
ops.details: Replace callers of the compatibility delegates in Misc with direct calls to the corresponding existing methods in NPCUtil. Preserve nullable handling for isNPCIncludingVillagers.

outputs: Misc without the NPC compatibility delegates
NPCUtil as the owner of the NPC classification API
ops.details: Consolidate the compatibility delegates into the existing NPCUtil implementation. Do not create duplicate methods; retain the existing NPCUtil implementations and remove the obsolete delegate declarations from Misc after call sites have been updated.

blocks.goal: Reduce the remaining utility class surface by isolating the experience-orb spawning implementation from Misc.

outputs: A same-package class responsible for experience-orb spawning
Misc without the experience-orb spawning implementation and SpawnOrbTask
ops.details: Extract spawnExperienceOrb and the related private SpawnOrbTask into one cohesive same-package class. Preserve the current null-world checks, entity type, experience value, and behavior. Update callers to the extracted class before removing the original method and nested task from Misc.

outputs: Call sites invoking the extracted experience-orb spawning method
ops.details: Update all callers of Misc.spawnExperienceOrb to use the extracted same-package class while preserving the existing static invocation behavior.
